name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: 'fd2_' game prefix + clear 'delay_ms' descriptor. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix). Already migrated from the synthetic emit-pipeline name __delay_thunk_375b2 to this name. Name accurately reflects the function's role: a thin millisecond-delay wrapper.
purpose: Thin millisecond-delay wrapper: pauses execution for the given number of milliseconds by tail-calling the Watcom CRT __delay (delay()).
logic_summary: The binary body is a single instruction: JMP to the Watcom CRT __delay (0x3DCCD). Ghidra inlines the __delay target into the decompilation, which shows the canonical Watcom busy-wait: if ms != 0, compute uVar2 = (ms * data_crt_delay_calibration_counter + 500) / 1000 (rounded, clamped to >=1), then loop that many times issuing INT 21h (swi(0x21)) per iteration until the counter hits zero. The src emits void fd2_delay_ms(uint32 ms){ delay(ms); }, which the compiler re-emits as the equivalent CRT tail-call.

params.name: ms
params.semantics: Delay duration in milliseconds. Callers pass small fixed literals (e.g. 0x50 ~= 80ms, 0x190 = 400ms) wherever a fixed pause is needed. Forwarded unchanged to the CRT delay()/__delay routine.
params.reason: Name 'ms' precisely describes the milliseconds argument and matches its use (forwarded to delay()). No address residue, not a param_N placeholder.

returns.semantics: No return value; the function returns after the delay completes.

notes: Comment verdict keep: both the src comment block (misc.c lines 413-425) and the Ghidra plate already accurately and concisely describe this as a thin tail-call delay wrapper (was synthetic __delay_thunk_375b2, 50+ game-wide callers); they are mutually consistent and ASCII, so no edit to src and no plate update needed. reads_globals lists data_crt_delay_calibration_counter because Ghidra inlines the tail-called __delay body into the decompilation; the read physically occurs inside the CRT __delay routine, not in the 1-instruction thunk itself. The src emits delay(ms) so this dependency is satisfied via the CRT, not via direct global access in the emitted source. Only the shard is staged (no src/plate change).
